entities.summary: Austrian, a notable figure in the history of Ukraine, associated with Russian & Austrian Partition of Ukraine (1772–1914). Preceded by Galicia & Habsburg Ukraine and Greek Catholic Church. Their legacy influenced Taras Shevchenko publishes Kobzar (1840) — birth of modern Ukrainian literature.
